cards.card_text: The LORD says each of the people follows the ___ of his evil heart instead of obeying Him.
cards.verse_text: See how each of you follows the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of obeying Me.
cards.snippet: …each of you follows the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of obeying Me.

cards.card_text: Paul writes, "You were running so well," and then he asks who has obstructed them from obeying the truth.
cards.verse_text: Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
cards.snippet: Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
